model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the percentage of respondents who believe various measures could limit “hidden economy” activity within a country. The horizontal axis displays a list of proposed measures, presented in alphabetical order, and the vertical axis represents the percentage of respondents, ranging from 0% to 20%. The scale is linear, with tick labels indicating values every 5%. The tallest bar, representing “Да се подобри качеството на административните…”, has a value of 13%, while the shortest bar, representing “Да се вьедат по-ефективни стимули за бизнеса”, has a value of 5%.  Several bars are colored pink, including “Да се ограничи действанията на мафията” with a value of 10%, “Да се облекчат условията за получаване на кредит” with a value of 3%, and “Да се насили данъчния контрол” with a value of 9%.  The remaining bars are colored blue and have values ranging from 2% to 5%.
